rules.sentence: Abdominopelvic MRI is considered highly sensitive and specific for diagnosing acute appendicitis.
The indications for MRI evaluation of suspected acute appendicitis are limited to particular patient populations for whom radiation exposure is less desirable.
If accessible, MRI is the second-most preferred imaging modality in pregnant patients with suspected acute appendicitis.
MRI findings consistent with acute appendicitis parallel those observed in other modalities, such as luminal distension and dilation, wall thickening, and free periappendiceal fluid.[28]
The Alvarado scoring system has been used to evaluate suspected acute appendicitis since 1986, and the modified Alvarado scoring system is the most widely used in current practice.
